set.name: Group Item
set.description: One item of a Group field: a collapsible card with a header (drag handle, optional icon preview, title, summary, duplicate/remove actions, chevron) and a body with the sub-fields. States: Expanded, Collapsed, Dragging (lifted while reordering), Error (collapsed item that holds an invalid sub-field).
